title: Welcome to AutoTrack
excerpt: Your new home for publishing news. Log in to the admin dashboard and start writing.
content:
AutoTrack is ready.

Go to /admin to log in with the password in your .env.local file (default: autotrack).

From the dashboard you can add a headline, summary, full story, category, and photo for each article. Delete this welcome post once you've published your first real story.
author: AutoTrack Desk

title: How to Publish Your First Story
excerpt: A short walkthrough: log in, write a story, pick a category, upload a photo.
content:
Log in at /admin/login using the password in .env.local.

Click 'New Story'. Fill in the title, a one-sentence summary, the full text, and choose a category. You can also upload a photo.

Save — the story appears at the top of the homepage immediately.
author: AutoTrack Desk
